$comment: Single source of truth for which model does which work. Enforced by .claude/hooks/enforce-routing.sh (PreToolUse on the Agent tool) and by the model: line in each .claude/agents/*.md file. Change a rule here, not in chat. Built-in helper agents (Explore, Plan, claude-code-guide, statusline-setup, web-fetch) are exempt from the explicit model rule, so plan mode keeps working.

language.rule: Translate source language to English first, then English to the target language. Never translate directly between two non-English languages.
